Finding submitted.

**TRANSITION — deviation (fallback target)**

- **What exists:** Section 7.5(a) (p0343) requires Servicer cooperation in an orderly transition on resignation or termination; 7.5(b) (p0344/p0346) requires transfer of funds and delivery of Receivable Files and records to the Successor Servicer; 7.5(c) puts transition expenses on the outgoing Servicer; Section 3.10(f) (p0147) covers custodian file delivery.
- **Why it fails fallback:** no minimum transition assistance period at all, and file/record delivery is only "as soon as practicable" — no 30-day export deadline.
- **Cure (two surgical replaces, minimality gate ok:true):** a 90-day assistance floor appended to 7.5(a), and "As soon as practicable" → "Within thirty (30) days" in 7.5(b), which carries the deadline through to both the funds transfer and the Receivable Files/records delivery.
- **Not pursued:** preferred-level six months, machine-readable format and certified deletion (not required at fallback); the p0346 carve-out is noted in the rationale as directed at Servicer software/processes and third-party-restricted materials rather than the express files-and-records delivery obligation.
